title.narrative: Economic empowerment of the most vulnerable families in Pakistan through livestock distribution

description.narrative: 1,000 beneficiaries will receive 2 goats each, totaling 2,000 goats. - Goat breeders will receive 4 bags of feed each, totaling 4,000. - 1,000 goat-breeding families will receive training in livestock care and breeding. - 1,000 beneficiaries will receive 25 poultry each, totaling 25,000. - Poultry breeders will receive 2 bags of feed each. Poultry farming, totaling 2000 units. - Poultry farmers will receive one set of equipment for raising poultry. - 1000 families will be trained in raising and caring for poultry. - 500 beneficiaries will receive one cow each, totaling 500 head of cattle. - Cattle farmers will receive two bundles of feed, totaling 1000 units. - 500 cattle farming families will be trained in caring for and raising cattle.
Supporting the most vulnerable families in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province, Pakistan, by training them in livestock breeding and care. Beneficiaries will receive livestock, feed, and necessary tools.

The project aims to provide a decent life and a source of income for 2,500 families in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province, Pakistan. This will be achieved through their economic empowerment by training beneficiaries in livestock breeding and distributing livestock, feed, and necessary tools.
